name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme / TN Old Age Pension (OAP)
short_description: Social security welfare pension provided by the Government of Tamil Nadu and Central NSAP to impoverished senior citizens who have no regular source of financial support.
benefits: ₹1,200 per month credited directly to the beneficiary's Aadhaar-seeded bank account via DBT, plus 2 sets of free dhotis/sarees annually during Pongal/Deepavali, and free rice scheme benefits.
required_documents: Smart Ration Card (BPL proof / PHH card)
Age Proof (Voter ID / Birth Certificate / Transfer Certificate or Medical Officer Age Certificate)
VAO Destitute Certificate (confirming applicant has no adequate financial support)
how_to_apply: Submit application online via the Tamil Nadu e-Sevai citizen portal (tnesevai.tn.gov.in) under Revenue Department services (REV-401) or visit your nearest Arasu e-Sevai / Taluk Office. Field verification is conducted by the VAO and Special Tahsildar (Social Security Schemes).

name: Destitute Widow Pension Scheme (DWP / IGNWPS)
short_description: Financial assistance scheme to rehabilitate destitute widows who have no adequate means of livelihood or support from adult family members.
benefits: ₹1,200 per month via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into bank account, plus free clothing and subsidized/free rice.
required_documents: Destitute Widow Certificate issued by Tahsildar / Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO)
how_to_apply: Apply through Arasu e-Sevai centre or online at tnesevai.tn.gov.in (Service Code REV-402). The application is reviewed by the Revenue Inspector and sanctioned by the Special Tahsildar (SSS).

name: Differently Abled Welfare Pension Scheme (DAP / IGNDPS)
short_description: Enhanced monthly subsistence pension for persons with disabilities (benchmark disability 40% and above) to support living expenses and medical care.
benefits: ₹1,500 per month (recently enhanced by the Tamil Nadu Government from ₹1,000) transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
required_documents: National Disability Identity Card (UDID) or Medical Board Disability Certificate (40% or more)
Age Proof (Voter ID, School TC, or Birth Certificate)
how_to_apply: Apply through Arasu e-Sevai centres, online via tnesevai.tn.gov.in, or submit directly to the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer (DDAWO) / Taluk Tahsildar.

name: Destitute Deserted Wives Pension Scheme (DDWPS)
short_description: Monthly welfare grant provided to women who have been legally divorced or deserted by their husbands for 5 years or more and have no financial support.
benefits: ₹1,200 per month paid through DBT directly to bank account, along with free clothings during festive seasons and free rice distribution.
required_documents: Deserted Wife Certificate issued by Tahsildar / Legal Court Divorce Decree
Age Proof document (Voter ID or Birth Certificate)
Proof showing separation / desertion for more than 5 years (affidavit / VAO report)
how_to_apply: Apply online at tnesevai.tn.gov.in or visit the local Arasu e-Sevai / Taluk Office. Field verification is conducted by the VAO and Social Security Scheme officers.
